method.source: Supplied combined testing base; independent CSV/pandas calculation, no app code or pack calculation scripts imported
method.record_grain: One synthetic current customer per wave; channel outcomes share the customer row and use only their own channel-user flag
method.wave_policy: 1, 2 and 3 separately; pooled is explicitly the three independent cross-sections combined with original weights, not a panel or single-period population
method.population: Customer files only; optional noncustomers, reference rows and metadata never enter respondent bases
method.weights: Unchanged positive finite weight once per customer for company estimates and once within the selected channel. No channel-count adjustment or renormalisation
method.bases: Eligible and valid raw n, sum of original weights, Kish (sum w)^2/sum w^2. Unweighted estimator uses unit weights and effective base equals raw n
method.missing: Valid satisfaction/continuation/agreement codes 1..5; valid recommend/switch 0..10. Blank, 98, 99 excluded from valid bases; valid zero retained. Routed channel blanks are never zero
method.statistics: Mean=sum(w*x)/sum(w); top two=100*sum(w*[4 or 5])/sum(w); NPS=promoter 9..10 percent minus detractor 0..6 percent with passives 7..8 retained; switching risk is declared 8..10 cut-off, not reverse scored satisfaction
method.scope: Overall company CSAT refers to past three months or since joining if shorter. Channel CSAT refers to latest experience in past 30 days. Continue and switch refer to next 12 months; price switch is agreement, not actual churn
method.reference_tolerance: Counts exact; all expected values and weighted bases compared at absolute 0.000001. Comparisons below cover only the requested core variables, not all pack references
method.no_inference: No independent-sample channel test; channels overlap by respondent. Kish alone does not account for dependence. All figures synthetic, not real market evidence
method.xlsx_parity_note: The All_Waves Respondents workbook was independently read back against CSV. Source identifiers remain strings; no leading-zero conversion is permitted.
